decisions.reason: Locates patch.yml target/anchor, cordis.patch.yml declaration and apply-patch.mjs; explains textual host-source patch vs composition and ties target to private SessionView path.
Locates producer/consumer and ignorable:true; correctly folds alpha.1 removal against alpha.2 restoration, keeps the marker, and makes no Session.append claim.

Locates apiProxy usage and removal correctly and avoids prescribing a nonexistent Host remote, but never explains Host domain-service injection (llm/listProviders); says replacement is undeterminable.
Locates the hardcoded path and says derive it from the host, but never names runtime DSH_HOME/profile resolution; correctly makes no --profile-introduced-in-alpha.1 claim.
Locates both the /internal SessionView import and registerCommand; explains the decomposition moved the view to the client side and that the public seam/API must be re-derived and verified.
Locates the dead loopback server; states an unauthenticated plugin-owned loopback surface must be re-expressed as a Gateway-authenticated channel, i.e. loopback does not exempt auth.

Locates both dsh calls and the JSON.parse/JSONL assumption and explains final-text stdout, but attributes the break to an alpha.2 stdout change (the assumption was already wrong) and never mentions stderr progress.

Couplings are substantively tied to the right changes by name/evidence (apiProxy, ignorable removal+restoration, session-view split, profile dir, channel) but expressed in a self-derived ID space that diverges from the registry, includes inferred cards, and misfiles a --profile invocation change as alpha.1 card A1-03.

Accounts for all seven hit categories and states scan limits extensively, but does not propose target-version build/typecheck, isolated boot, or a functional verification path — only registry consultation.
